TASK: predicts the original identities of the corrupted tokens
predicts whether each token in the corrupted input was replaced by a generator sample or not

groups.label: USED_FOR
groups.supportExcerpt: Masked language modeling (MLM) pre-training methods such as BERT corrupt the input by replacing some tokens with [MASK] and then train a model to reconstruct the original tokens.
groups.reason: BERT is explicitly a masked-language/token-reconstruction method; repeated MLM and BERT mentions are correlated source-local references.

groups.label: USED_FOR
groups.supportExcerpt: As an alternative, we propose a more sample-efficient pre-training task called replaced token detection. Instead of masking the input, our approach corrupts it by replacing some tokens with plausible alternatives sampled from a small generator network. Then, instead of training a model that predicts the original identities of the corrupted tokens, we train a discriminative model that predicts whether each token in the corrupted input was replaced by a generator sample or not.
groups.reason: The discriminator directly performs replacement detection, not the rejected original-identity prediction objective.

groups.label: NO_RELATION
groups.supportExcerpt: Then, instead of training a model that predicts the original identities of the corrupted tokens, we train a discriminative model that predicts whether each token in the corrupted input was replaced by a generator sample or not.
